name: Foggy Harbour Realism
description: The calm in-video scene look for sleep narration — near-photoreal painted quaysides in sea mist, grey-teal and slate, one warm light source, nothing moving and no faces close to camera.
style_bible: Near-photoreal painted stillness: the surface of a carefully finished oil or gouache study handled so tightly that it reads almost as a photograph, with brushwork visible only where wet stone or rope catches the light. Medium and surface: smooth blended passages, no exposed canvas tooth, no impasto except a few small highlights on water and metal, an even matte finish. Edges and shapes: soft everywhere and softer with distance — foreground objects hold a clean but unlined edge, the middle ground loses its edges to mist, the far ground dissolves entirely into flat tone with only a silhouette left. Palette: grey-teal, slate, wet stone, pewter, drab green and cold off-white, desaturated throughout and kept within a narrow band of value, with exactly one warm source — a lamp, a low sun through cloud, or a coal brazier — spilling amber into a small part of the frame and nowhere else. Lighting: flat, diffuse, sourceless daylight filtered through fog, contrast deliberately low, no hard shadows, no strong highlights, no rim light; the single warm source glows rather than illuminates and never casts a dramatic beam. Texture: sea mist as real depth rather than an overlay, damp on stone, salt bloom on timber, condensation on iron, hair-fine drizzle, still water holding a soft broken reflection. Subject grammar: wet stone quays and slipways, coiled rope, barrels and crates stacked and left, bollards, chain, mooring rings, lobster pots, nets drying, moored boats sitting quiet at their lines, a distant steamer showing a single vertical smoke plume, a lone gull settled on a post, a shuttered harbour building. Compose one crisp still-life detail in the near foreground, a readable but softened middle ground, and fog beyond. Framing: eye-level or slightly above, horizon low, generous empty air and water, subject placed off-centre and small within the frame. Low stimulation is the contract: nothing is in motion, nothing is beginning or ending, no faces appear in close-up, no crowds, no high contrast, no incident. Keep it content-independent: no fixed port, vessel, event, or copied composition.
negative_prompt: bright sunshine, clear blue sky, saturated colour, high contrast, hard shadows, dramatic god rays, sunset blaze, action, storm, crashing waves, running or fighting figures, close-up faces, portraits, crowds, busy markets, modern vessels, motorboats, cars, neon, signage, readable text, lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, borders, UI elements, HDR look, heavy vignette, cartoon, anime, flat vector, copied reference composition
